lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.title: Lukmanier · Oberalp · Vorderrhein High Roads · short arc
lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.slogan: Chur fuel to Vorderrhein valley flow

waypoints.name: Chur fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Chur is where the day begins. Next is Lukmanier pass road, climbing 1322 m.

waypoints.name: Lukmanier pass road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 1915 m here. The road climbs 1322 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 9 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Andermatt, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Andermatt base reset
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 471 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Oberalppass high road, climbing 600 m.

waypoints.name: Oberalppass high road
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 2044 m up. The road climbs 600 m on the way up to it, steadily. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Disentis food stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Disentis food stop
waypoints.advice: Food at 249 km, roughly 5 hours into the riding. You lose 914 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Vorderrhein valley flow, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Vorderrhein valley flow
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 311 km. You lose 480 m on the way down to it, steadily.

sections.advice: Chur fuel gate → Lukmanier pass road climbs about 1322 m in 80 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lukmanier pass road → Andermatt base reset drops about 471 m over 22 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Andermatt base reset → Oberalppass high road climbs about 600 m in 8 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Oberalppass high road → Disentis food stop drops about 914 m over 19 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Disentis food stop → Vorderrhein valley flow drops about 480 m over 35 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Chur fuel gate → Lukmanier pass road
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 152 km. 1322 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1915 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter. First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Furka-Grimsel-Susten Pass Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 35 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

lukmanier-oberalp-vorderrhein-high-roads.story: 311 km one way from Chur - plan on about 5 h 57 of riding. On the way it passes Andermatt and Disentis. The climbs: Lukmanier pass road and Oberalppass high road. It tops out at 2,044 m. Lukmanier Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The passes are the reason to go.
